name: 包豪斯
description: 红蓝黄三原色 #E30613/#004D9F/#F5A623，粗黑边框，几何构成主义风格，适合设计师、创意类内容

styles.h1: font-size: 31px; font-weight: 900; color: #ffffff; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.16; letter-spacing: -0.02em; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #E30613 0%, #E30613 64%, #004D9F 64%, #004D9F 86%, #F5A623 86%, #F5A623 100%); border: 3px solid #1a1a1a; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #1a1a1a; margin-top: 36px; margin-bottom: 18px;
styles.h2: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: #1a1a1a; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.35; letter-spacing: 0.08em; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #F5A623 0%, #F5A623 68%, #ffffff 68%, #ffffff 100%); border-left: 10px solid #004D9F; border-top: 3px solid #1a1a1a; border-bottom: 3px solid #1a1a1a; margin-top: 34px; margin-bottom: 18px;
styles.h3: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a1a; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.45; letter-spacing: 0.05em; background: #ffffff; border-left: 3px solid #E30613; margin-top: 28px; margin-bottom: 14px;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #1a1a1a; line-height: 1.75; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: border-left: 6px solid #F5A623; border-right: 2px solid #004D9F; border-top: 2px solid #1a1a1a; background: rgba(227,6,19,0.06); margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; border-radius: 0; font-size: 16px; color: #333333; line-height: 1.65;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 14px; color: #1a1a1a; line-height: 1.65; margin-bottom: 0; background: transparent; letter-spacing: 0.3px;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 0; display: block; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #1a1a1a; border: 2px solid #1a1a1a; background: #ffffff; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px;
styles.hr: margin-top: 36px; margin-bottom: 36px; height: 6px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #E30613 0%, #E30613 33.33%, #004D9F 33.33%, #004D9F 66.66%, #F5A623 66.66%, #F5A623 100%); border: none;
styles.code: background: rgba(227,6,19,0.06); border-radius: 0; font-size: 13px; color: #004D9F; font-family: 'SF Mono', Consolas, monospace;
styles.pre: background: #f0f0f0; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; border-left: 6px solid #E30613; color: #1a1a1a; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word; word-break: break-all;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; background: #e0e0e0;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #004D9F; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'SF Mono', Consolas, monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 24px; font-size: 15px; border-spacing: 0; border-radius: 0; overflow: hidden;
styles.th: background: #004D9F; border: 3px solid #1a1a1a; text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff;
styles.ol li::marker: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; min-width: 24px; background: #004D9F; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; margin-right: 10px; margin-top: 4px;
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #1a1a1a; line-height: 1.75; letter-spacing: 0.5px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 8px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes h2: font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; color: #1a1a1a; margin-bottom: 12px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #666666; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; word-break: break-all;
styles.blockquote strong: font-weight: 900; color: #1a1a1a; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 15px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.h4: font-size: 19px; font-weight: bold; color: #1a1a1a; border-left: 2px solid #E30613; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h5: font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; color: #555555; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h6: font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; color: #888888; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.3;
